test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. While India is home to 75 per cent of tigers in the world, the Global Tiger Day - as it is also known - sees awareness events organised in the country, as well as neighbouring Bangladesh and Nepal.

B. Its primary objective is to preserve the natural habitat of the tiger.

C. International Tiger Day was initiated in 2010, at the Saint Petersburg Tiger Summit.

D. This annual event, observed on 29 July, aims to create awareness on tiger conservation.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'CDBA'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a **Para Jumble.**
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually **an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.**
 
• **Sentence C **begins by introducing the topic of International **Tiger Day,** which was initiated in 2010 at the Saint Petersburg Tiger Summit. This sentence provides the context for the remaining sentences and explains what the paragraph will be about.
 
• **Sentence D **then explains that International **Tiger Day** is observed annually on **29 July **and aims to create awareness about tiger conservation. This sentence expands on the topic introduced in **sentence C **and adds another important detail about the day.
 
• **Sentence B** follows and states the primary objective of preserving the natural habitat of the tiger. This sentence is important because it highlights the main purpose of tiger conservation efforts, which is to ensure that tigers have a safe and secure natural environment to live in.
 
• Finally, **sentence A **provides additional detail by mentioning that while India is home to 75% of tigers in the world, neighboring countries like Bangladesh and Nepal also organize awareness events on this day. This sentence provides a geographical context for the day and emphasizes that tiger conservation is a global issue.
 
• Overall, the correct sequence of the sentences (CDBA) forms a coherent paragraph that introduces the topic of International Tiger Day, explains its objectives and importance, and provides additional details about tiger conservation efforts around the world.

 

**Correct Sequence:__** *International Tiger Day was initiated in 2010, at the Saint Petersburg Tiger Summit. This annual event, observed on 29 July, aims to create awareness on tiger conservation. Its primary objective is to preserve the natural habitat of the tiger. While India is home to 75 per cent of tigers in the world, the Global Tiger Day - as it is also known - sees awareness events organised in the country, as well as neighbouring Bangladesh and Nepal.*
